changeSet.author: Fiter
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_prequalification_group g INNER JOIN ( SELECT mpgm.group_id, MIN(ms.agency_id) AS agency_id FROM m_prequalification_group_members mpgm INNER JOIN m_client mc ON mc.dpi = mpgm.dpi INNER JOIN m_group_client mgc ON mgc.client_id = mc.id INNER JOIN m_group mg ON mg.id = mgc.group_id INNER JOIN m_group center ON center.id = mg.parent_id INNER JOIN m_portfolio mp ON mp.id = center.portfolio_id INNER JOIN m_supervision ms ON ms.id = mp.supervision_id WHERE ms.agency_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mpgm.group_id ) memberAgency ON memberAgency.group_id = g.id SET g.agency_id = memberAgency.agency_id WHERE g.prequalification_type_enum = 1;

changeSet.author: Fiter
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_prequalification_group g INNER JOIN m_supervision ms on ms.agency_id = g.agency_id SET g.supervision_office_id = ms.linked_office_id WHERE g.prequalification_type_enum =2;
